item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: AI model management in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now offers limited preview support for AI model management, letting users provision fully managed models directly in the database. The preview covers embeddings, semantic ranking, and generation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Managed AI Models in Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Managed AI Models are in public preview for Azure Logic Apps Automation. They let developers add AI capabilities to workflows and agents without provisioning, deploying, or managing model infrastructure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Unified Model API in Azure API Management
item.description:
Azure API Management now provides a Generally Available Unified Model API for connecting applications to AI models from multiple providers through a single standardized interface. It reduces the need to manage provider-specific APIs and integration requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — September update
item.description:
GitHub’s September 2026 Visual Studio Copilot update adds pull request exploration in chat, support for choosing the AI model your team uses, and package vulnerability fixes surfaced directly from Visual Studio.

  • Source: GitHub
